verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an email client, but nothing in the evidence documents any setting to disable Superhuman's product telemetry or usage analytics. The community items about read-receipt pixel tracking and not being able to turn images off concern tracking of email recipients, not the product's own telemetry, so they don't count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
